claims.text: TaskPebble stores tasks in a local JSON file.

evidence.quote: TaskPebble stores tasks in a local JSON file.

claims.text: Each TaskPebble task has a title and a completed boolean.

evidence.quote: Each task has a title and a completed boolean.

claims.text: TaskPebble lists tasks in creation order.

evidence.quote: The command `python taskpebble.py list` prints all tasks in creation order.

claims.text: TaskPebble can mark a selected task complete by number.

evidence.quote: The command `python taskpebble.py complete <number>` marks the selected task complete.
